scene_summary: A pale blue paper plate lies on teal vine-patterned cloth, with a curled upper-right corner, torn diagonal seam, graphite flower arcs, tiny pinhole clusters, red botanical rubs, an edge notch with warm light, and a small candle-cake glint near the lower field.

detected_objects.label: hero paper-edge aperture
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The upper-right paper corner is visibly curled and torn back, exposing the teal cloth beneath and forming a dominant paper-edge aperture with shadow and rough fibrous edges.

detected_objects.label: hero floral corner pressure
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A saturated red rubbed botanical/ink fragment presses along the lower-left paper edge, cropped by the border and dense enough to serve as a source-bearing corner mass.

detected_objects.label: coral wreath seam
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A long frayed diagonal paper seam crosses the sheet, carrying pale botanical-border energy as a thin torn line with fiber and shadow.

detected_objects.label: special-card repair tear
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small coral-raspberry scuffed patch interrupts the upper-left open paper field, appearing like a repaired printable-card fragment rather than text.

detected_objects.label: template-index pinholes
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A grid-like cluster of tiny raised pinholes and dimples sits on the right paper field near the vine-side ground, clearly visible as small puncture marks.

detected_objects.label: atlas-vine interruption
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A sparse olive-green broken vine or route-like scatter crosses the lower-right paper field, distinct from empty space and visually tied to the patterned ground.

detected_objects.label: tier-slice candle glint
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small graphite cake-like dense mark with five vertical candle stems and warm flame tips sits near the bottom field, compressing the tier/slice source into tiny candle glints.

detected_objects.label: bottom dense graphite constellation
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A low scatter of dark graphite pinpoints and flecks spans the lower paper, forming a dense ground mark beneath the drawn gestures without becoming a broad arbitrary region.

detected_objects.label: tier-slice candle glint
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Planned source surface fallback used because plate inspection returned fewer mapped objects than source bindings.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate is spacious and expressionist: one pale paper body, one teal vine ground, and a few controlled marks. Source windows can bind to real cuts, seams, flecks, and pinholes without visual clutter.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
